Building a static site generator from scratch is textbook **NIH syndrome**. Mature alternatives (11ty, Hugo, Astro) handle all these requirements with ~10 lines of config and have solved years of edge cases (nested partials, circular includes, encoding, incremental builds, template caching, error recovery).
